zh:
延世大学（Yonsei University）创建于1885年，坐落于韩国首尔，是韩国历史最悠久的大学之一，与首尔大学、高丽大学并称韩国“SKY”顶尖名校，为世界知名的私立研究型大学。学校下设20余个学院，涵盖人文社科、理工、医学、商学、艺术等多个学科领域，在校生规模庞大。
延世大学在医学、商科、工学、传媒、社会科学等领域拥有顶尖学术实力，国际化程度高，在全球高校中享有极高声誉。2026QS世界大学排名中，延世大学位列世界第76位。
en:
Yonsei University is a prestigious private research university located in Seoul, South Korea. Founded in 1885, it is one of the oldest universities in South Korea and widely recognized as one of the top three universities (SKY) in the country. The university consists of more than 20 colleges covering humanities, social sciences, science and technology, medicine, business, arts and other fields.
Yonsei University has outstanding academic strength in medicine, business, engineering, media and social sciences, with a high level of internationalization. It is ranked 76th globally in the 2026 QS World University Rankings.
